title: Morning / Evening Rhythm
concept: Two short daily check-ins that keep you actually in touch — the fix for drifting into just running a household together.
whenToUse: When you're drifting, feeling more like roommates, just back from travel, or connection's turned purely logistical.
steps: Morning check-in (5 min or less) — how are you going into today? Phones down if you can.
Evening check-in (about 10 min) — how did today actually go, plus one thing you appreciated.
Keep the same times most days.
Track yes/no for a week; adjust the timing, not how much you're doing.

phrases.text: How are you going into today?

working: Phones down through the morning hug and check-in. Ten minutes together in the evening before emails. The drift stays small.
notWorking: “You good?” while scrolling your phone. Going through the motions without actually being present doesn't work.
activity: Pick your exact times for the next 7 days. Track it somewhere you both see. Pair it with your daily check-in.
